{{Top|leg}}
The '''Shoolbloorp''' was a special [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]], that was used as the traditional mating site for the [[Ergesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Two Ergesh would meet at the swamp, and during a mating ceremony, each would plant a seed from their own body in the swamp. These seeds would combine to form a new Ergesh youngling.
